import pandas as pd

# Check the trips table structure and key moments
trips = tables['trips']
print("Trips shape:", trips.shape)
print("\nClass distribution in season 2:")
print(trips['cls'].value_counts())

# Season 2 yellowtail per class and week
print("\n=== Season 2 YT Performance by Week (doy groups) ===")
trips['week'] = (trips['fish_date_doy'] // 7) * 7
season2 = trips[trips['fish_date_season'] == 2]

week_class = season2.groupby(['week', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()
week_class['yt_per_angler'] = week_class['yt'] / week_class['anglers']
week_class = week_class.sort_values(['week', 'yt_per_angler'], ascending=[True, False])
print(week_class[week_class['yt'] > 0].to_string())
